motion.name: line-to-dot
motion.value: stroke-dashoffset set each frame so the line ends at the dot; the dot keeps level with 60% of the window where the line runs down, steady pace where it runs across
motion.purpose: The page's one story, tied to the scroll both ways.

motion.name: first-draw
motion.value: the desk then the line draw over 1.5s, cubic ease-out

motion.name: field-drift
motion.value: each row translateX(-50%) to 0, linear, 40 to 110s, infinite; paused off screen
motion.purpose: The character field, as output running.

motion.name: field-ripple
motion.value: a ring of scrambled characters to 180px (120 on a phone) over 1.1s, fading; ember spark 0.8s
motion.purpose: A click or touch on the field.

motion.name: caret
motion.purpose: The ember caret in the field.

motion.name: phones-together
motion.value: back phone from -90px 46px, front from 110px 70px and 6deg, to rest over 0.7 of a screen, cubic ease-out
motion.purpose: The phones as their section arrives.

motion.name: phone-tap
motion.value: a ring scaling 0.4 to 1.6 and a press over 0.9s
motion.purpose: The Allow, as the dot arrives under the phone.

motion.name: native-banner
motion.value: translateX(290px) to 0 at 14% (expo out), back at 76% (expo in), 5s loop

motion.name: private-pulse
motion.value: translateX 0 to 246px and back, 3.6s ease-in-out loop
motion.purpose: The note between computer and phone.

motion.name: reduce-motion
motion.value: every loop stops; the line is whole and the dot at Download; the drawings at their telling frame

narrative.overview:
Every agent, one trail, drawn as one ink line that runs the whole page. The first screen stands in
a field of characters, the agents' own output running in rows, that thins out to nothing at the
desk; there the one line takes over. It is the desk under Trek's window, turns down the right edge,
becomes the ground the two phones stand on, runs down the left edge past everything Trek does,
closes round "your computer and phone", and stops at the Download button, over the same field of
characters lying still. The ember dot at the line's head is the thread that needs you: it carries
"Run ./migrate?" from the desk to the phone, where its Allow is tapped, and rests at Download. The
line is drawn exactly to the dot as the page scrolls, never past it; scrolled to the end, the line
is whole.

The world is paper and ink: a pale lilac paper by day, a deep violet-black at night, a 512 px paper
tooth over both, one ink weight for the line and the drawings, and ember for the one thing that
needs you. Type is two grotesques, upright, and a monospace face for the field only.
keyCharacteristics: One line, one dot, one ember. Ember is the dot, the main button, the caret in the field, and the
The character field is text, not a picture: rows built once and slid by CSS transforms. A click
Drawings are ink lines on the page's paper (faces filled with it, so what is behind stays
The product is shown alive: Trek's window redrawn so it can act (and saying so), and real iPhone
Every colour is defined for Paper and Night, following the system.
Reads whole with Reduce Motion on: the field and drawings stand still, the line is drawn whole
dos: Keep the line drawn exactly to the dot, and whole at the end of the page.
Keep every claim true for the latest release; tag what is Mac only, partial or a preview.
Run `python3 script/site/stamp.py site` after any change under `site/`.
Keep all styling in the stylesheets and all script in files: the CSP forbids inline styles and scripts. Script may set custom properties through the CSSOM.
donts: Don't draw anything outdoors (hills, trails, mountains), and don't use the mark as scenery.
Don't let a line leave the privacy box or stop short of a joint.
Don't load type, script or pictures from another domain; the only request elsewhere is GitHub's release API, for the download.
Don't add trackers, analytics or cookies.
